name: Excel
author: Saeed
description: Read, create and edit .xlsx workbooks: sheets, cell ranges, formulas, new rows.

tools.name: list_sheets
tools.description: List the sheets of an .xlsx file with their size.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read cells from a sheet as rows. Optional range like A1:F40. Formulas return their last result.

tools.name: write_cells
tools.description: Write values or formulas into cells. Creates the file or sheet if missing. cells: [{ref:'B2', value:12} or {ref:'C2', formula:'B2*2'}]

tools.name: append_rows
tools.description: Add rows at the bottom of a sheet. rows is a list of lists.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create a new workbook. sheets: [{name, rows:[[...]]}] (first row is usually the header).
